content.title: Why Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of government consulting firm Booz Allen Hamilton (NYSE:BAH) fell 6.9% in the afternoon session after the company announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Matthew Calderone was resigning. The resignation was set to be effective February 1, 2026.
